integrity: Proof uses explicit Hoeffding kernels, spectral summations, and a bundled deterministic numerical checker; numerical finite tests are not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly angular-uniform independent planar directions, deletion of one point; zero covariance does not imply independence, and an expected jackknife ratio is not an almost-sure ratio. title: Joint second-chaos and Gaussian deletion law for central simplicial depth
